qa.answer:
No, you can't activate it.
When a Digimon is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, it will only be pending activation for the Digimon card with that digivolution card.
If a card with an effect that's pending activation leaves that area before the effect activates, the effect can no longer be activated.
In this case, if BT20-068 [Bakemon] is deleted and an [On Deletion] effect on a digivolution card is triggered, the effect will only be pending activation for BT20-068 [Bakemon].
If the deleted BT20-068 [Bakemon] leaves the trash, the inherited [On Deletion] effect that was pending activation can no longer be activated.
